item.title: Sweep-Line algorithm for intersections
item.description:
Suppose you're given a lot of lines. Your task is to give a list of all pairs of lines that cross.

The list of lines might be something like this:

  • a: {(1|4),(6|1)}
  • b: {(2|1),(5|4)}
  • c: {(3|1),(6|4)}
  • d: {(4|1),(8|5 …
